sources.title: Review of Sites of Memory, Sites of Mourning
sources.citation: David Fitzpatrick, review of Jay Winter, Sites of Memory, Sites of Mourning: The Great War in European Cultural History, Cambridge1995, archived Institute of Historical Research, History in Focus: War; selected memorials discussion.

verification.note: Fresh full official archived review text retrieved; opening and memorials/primary-function discussion read with surrounding paragraphs, not all review or Winter’s original book. Explicitly credits Winter’s development of Mosse’s research and contrasts primary bereavement functions with political appropriation; reviewer also qualifies Winter’s generalizations. Book publication1995 is not assumed review date; original publication date not established from archive metadata. Named Fitzpatrick mediation retained, not a new direct reading of either book.
